verdict.rationale: MoonPay's enterprise page claims first-party infrastructure to issue fiat-backed stablecoins with built-in minting, redemption, compliance, onboarding, and distribution. That is the product's own capability, but the evidence is a single marketing line with no developer documentation behind it. missing for 10: reserve management, explicit branded-issuance details, any issuance docs or API reference, honestly quoted gating or eligibility terms, independent or hands-on corroboration.
